notes.title: Teams & Matchmaking
notes.notes: This release introduces the first version of parties and matchmaking. Players can now quickly find and join existing games, form teams, and be matched against other teams.

notes.title: Coming Soon: Matchmaking
notes.notes: Right now, players can only join public servers or a friend’s game if they’re already online. In the next release, I'm adding matchmaking to make it much easier to find and join games, even with players outside their friends list. This should create a smoother and more accessible multiplayer experience for everyone.

notes.title: Minimal Moba v0.10.2
notes.notes: The mouse cursor now clamps to the game screen while in Windowed-Mode allowing map scrolling when the mouse is at the edge of the screen.

notes.title: Minimal Moba Playtest is Live!
notes.notes: The Minimal Moba Playtest is now open for all to download and play!  I plan on keeping the playtest open for the foreseeable future as I gather feedback and continue to develop the game.
